ticket.subject: Do not sell or share my personal information
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

Please treat this as a CCPA request to stop selling or sharing my personal information.

I am a user in the Fennimore Freight workspace.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Please confirm once this is done.

Many thanks,
Priya Castellano
